timeline.summary: On April 18, 2026, Neogen Chemicals allotted 10,00,000 equity shares at ₹1,610 per share via preferential issue to Cadamba Solutions Private Limited, raising ₹161 Cr.
On April 28, 2026, Neogen Chemicals announced that its subsidiary Neogen Ionics will infuse ₹100.11 Cr into step-down subsidiary Neogen Morita via a rights issue.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹246.56 Cr (+21.6% YoY), net profit ₹11.39 Cr.
On May 17, 2026, Neogen Chemicals released its Q4 and FY26 earnings presentation, guiding FY27 standalone revenue to ₹875-950 crore.
Neogen Chemicals Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share for FY26, subject to shareholder approval.
Neogen Chemicals Limited hosted its Earnings Conference Call for Analysts/Investors on May 18, 2026, at 4:30 p.m., with recording available at https://neogenchem.com/wp-content/uploads/ecr004.mp3.
On May 25, 2026, Neogen Chemicals filed the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call held on May 18, 2026.

On its 27 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Neogen raised FY27 base-business revenue guidance to ₹950–1,050 Cr after 34% revenue growth, kept battery chemicals at ₹300 Cr and said the board approved a ₹600 Cr QIP.
Neogen Chemicals approved expanding its organo-lithium manufacturing facility at Patancheru from 300 MT/PA to 600 MT/PA with an investment of up to ₹45 Cr.
